ValidationRule.description: Date of Final Service is Required when Order Scheduled Date is populated
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name = "CLAS – Data Management", NOT(ISBLANK( Order_Scheduled_date__c )), ISBLANK( Date_of_Final_Service__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: 'Date of Final Service' is required when a date is entered in 'Order Scheduled Date' field
